verdicts.claim: the premise holds on the tasks themselves: asked directly, west is right on at least 10 points more of them than east, while east advertises more
verdicts.saw: asked directly: west right on 65.6%, east on 55.2%; east advertises 0.9 (its real unseen-case AUC 0.623517), west 0.750056

verdicts.claim: organ 8’s rule never finds the over-claimer out: at most 10% of late routed tasks go to west
verdicts.saw: organ 8’s rule: 0 of 90 late routed tasks to west (0%)

verdicts.claim: the evidence rule finds it out without any exploring: at least 80% of late routed tasks go to west
verdicts.saw: the evidence rule, no exploring: 71 of 90 late routed tasks to west (78.9%); first sent to west in round 1

verdicts.claim: with the evidence rule, the share of tasks answered right in the last 10 rounds is at least 10 points above organ 8’s rule
verdicts.saw: right in the last 10 rounds: organ 8’s rule 52.2%, reliability 52.2%, reliability + exploring 52.2%, evidence 56.7%

verdicts.claim: reliability + exploring finds it out partly: at least 50% of late routed tasks go to west
verdicts.saw: reliability + exploring: 22 of 90 late routed tasks to west (24.4%)

verdicts.claim: in all four runs every message is admitted by the gate
verdicts.saw: organ 8’s rule 1140/1140; reliability 1140/1140; reliability + exploring 1140/1140; evidence 1140/1140 messages admitted
